title: Automated screening of Parkinson's Disease using Smooth Pursuit Eye Movements
abstract: arXiv:2610.33359v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Smooth pursuit eye movements are frequently altered in Parkinson's disease, but previous studies have relied mainly on conventional parameters that describe the relationship between gaze and target. This study investigates whether complexity and nonlinear dynamics measures of the gaze position sequences can support the automatic screening of Parkinson's disease. Gaze position sequences were recorded with a video eye tracker in 41 participants with early Parkinson's disease and 47 healthy controls during 12 smooth pursuit tasks. Four experimental frameworks and four embedding delay strategies were compared. The selected experimental setting combined baseline wander removal with a fixed embedding delay. After feature selection, a support vector machine was trained for each task and axis and their outputs were combined in a mixture of experts. translated_title: 使用平滑追踪眼动自动筛查帕金森病
translated_abstract: 平滑追踪眼动在帕金森病患者中经常出现异常，但以往的研究主要依赖于描述注视点与目标之间关系的传统参数。本研究探讨注视位置序列的复杂性和非线性动力学指标能否支持帕金森病的自动筛查。研究使用视频眼动仪记录了41名早期帕金森病患者和47名健康对照者在12个平滑追踪任务中的注视位置序列，并比较了四种实验框架和四种嵌入延迟策略。最终选择的实验设置结合了基线漂移去除和固定嵌入延迟。经过特征选择后，针对每个任务和坐标轴分别训练支持向量机，并将它们的输出以专家混合的方式组合。该流程在70名参与者中开发完成，并在18名参与者的外部测试集上进行了评估。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于注视位置序列复杂性与非线性动力学特征的机器学习流程（支持向量机结合专家混合模型），可利用平滑追踪眼动数据实现对帕金森病的自动筛查。
en_tdlr: This study develops a machine learning pipeline based on complexity and nonlinear dynamics measures of gaze position sequences during smooth pursuit tasks, enabling automated screening of Parkinson's disease.
